Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The fee chart extracted with its columns interleaved: the rows for the intermediate license, the full Class F license and the permits were read where minimum age, cost and term lined up unambiguously, but the two school-bus-endorsement rows for drivers aged seventy-five and older could not be tied to a specific license row, so no fee is stated for them [A06] (verify MO-LIC-D-FEECHART).
The restriction-code table extracted as two side-by-side columns; only codes whose letter and meaning sat on the same extracted line were used [A07].
The lawful-status paragraph links to an online document list; only the documents printed in the guide itself were used, and the online list is treated as dynamic [A04].
Fees, website document lists and office contact details are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
Statute citations printed in the chapter (for example the Class E exemption statute) were summarized, not copied.
